rationale: M60 XML deep review, finding X2. An XSD is a GRAPH OF FILES and the edges are written as attribute VALUES: `schemaLocation` is a W3C-defined list of namespace/URI pairs whose URIs are file paths, and `type`/`base`/`ref` name declarations. The pre-fix analyzer emitted no edge for either class: measured over the 7,975-file corpus, 2,237 distinct QName attribute values across 11,948 occurrences in 511 files and 323 distinct `schemaLocation` targets, with recall 0.000. Three properties make the new edges honest rather than a flood. (1) The target of a `references` edge is the LOCAL NAME — the name a declaration carries — and the prefix rides in metadata, because a prefix in the target is a VALUE where a NAME belongs (M60.R10). (2) An edge is emitted only when the target RESOLVES in this document or is a known specification built-in; a value naming nothing this document declares is refused, so the graph never gains a name no file supports. (3) `schemaLocation`'s pairing is decided by its token COUNT: an even count is namespace/URI pairs, an odd count is one bare URI — so `xs:import` (a pair, line 5) and `xs:include` (a bare URI, line 6) both work and neither imports the other half. Lines are read off the file.

expectRelationships.note: a FILE, written by the document: schemaLocation's URI. The tier is import_based, not structural, because the fact is about another FILE.
a NAME reached through the declared prefix tns, so the edge is qualified: the namespace is what makes the name resolvable, and metadata carries both the prefix and the URI.

forbidRelationships.note: the namespace half of a schemaLocation pair is a namespace URI, not a file
an ODD token count is one bare URI; a pairing rule that assumed pairs would import the namespace of a neighbouring element
the prefix must never reach the target
same: the local name is the declaration's name

forbidSymbols.note: a reference value published as a symbol; the declaration's name is `CatalogType`

forbidSymbols.name: xs:string
forbidSymbols.note: same: the written value, not the local name

_targetSpelling: THE SAME-FILE TIER (2026-10-12): a target this file declares under EXACTLY ONE owner is emitted as `Owner.name` — the two-part identity the analyzer already computes (`qualifiedName = ownerName + '.' + name`) and which `parallel-indexer.ts:3435-3437` already looks up — so the store binds it without a store change. The bare name stays in `metadata.bareTarget`. A target the file declares under ZERO or 2+ owners is left exactly as it was.
